# Support

Movena is a community-maintained application. Search the documentation and
existing issues before opening a new report.

- Installation, source setup, and known platform constraints: [README](../README.md)
- Community discussion and quick support: [Discord Server](https://discord.gg/hRHpwVPjBN)
- Bug reports and feature requests: [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/movena-app/movena/issues)
- Security vulnerabilities: [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md)
- Near-term direction: [Roadmap](../docs/ROADMAP.md)

For playback problems, include the app version, operating system version,
source kind (Xtream, remote M3U, or local M3U), media kind, and exact steps.
Attach the app's sanitized diagnostic report when it helps. Do not disclose
credentials, playlist or stream URLs, provider responses, viewing history, or
copyrighted media. The project cannot provide IPTV subscriptions or support
third-party provider accounts.
